sources: Sources: official airport weather reports (4:00 PM) and airport forecasts (issued 1:00 PM) from aviationweather.gov for 10 airports. The other 26 airports have no official airport report, so they use the MET Norway location forecast (updated 3:17 PM to 4:32 PM) and are marked Estimate. Estimates show rain and wind only and cannot confirm thunderstorms, so an Estimate airport is never shown as Danger. For Estimates, bad weather means moderate or heavy rain (2.5 mm or more in an hour), or winds of 39 km/h or more. Tomorrow and days-ahead outlooks use the same airport forecasts and MET Norway estimates and are less certain than today's alerts.
